name: @pryzm/plugin-lift
description: PRYZM — Lift COMPOUND SYSTEM plugin (L-5700 / C104 / ADR-0325). A lift is a COMPOUND, not a primitive: lift.create composes a full-height shaft ENCLOSURE (walls, or curtain-wall glass for the standalone type) + ONE real landing DOOR per served level + the five LOD-300 CABIN parts + a VOID in every slab the shaft passes through, in ONE undo entry via produceMultiStoreCommand. lift.delete removes all of it AND heals every void. Geometry math lives in @pryzm/geometry-lift (pure).
